blind.method: each packet was rendered from stored record and source text only; the earlier verdict, its classes and its reason were read only after every answer was written and sealed

reference.rule:
The lead ruled on 2026-11-18 that a name identifies and its definition specifies.
A name carries only what separates the quantity from its neighbours: the kind of
quantity, the physical object or locus it describes, and the relation or
component where that separation depends on it. A definition carries everything a
reader needs to obtain the number: normalisations, weightings, averaging or
integration, conventions, coordinate frames, methods and units.

Two consequences decide every judgment:
1. A property that changes which quantity is meant belongs in the name. If the
   name leaves it out, the name does not identify the quantity.
2. A property that changes how the number is computed from the same quantity
   belongs to the definition. Its absence from the name is not a defect of the
   name. If the definition leaves it out, the definition is defective.

judge.blind_to: the arm and the incumbent; each verdict sees only the submitted record and the committed answer

rounds.change: baseline prompt: write the record from the case file with no identity rule stated
the prompt states the lead's identity rule and the definition's duty to carry normalisation, convention, method and unit, answering every failure class the first round recorded

withheld.unmeasurable: no held-out member has its right answer only in the enclosing text and is right for one-pass/frontier

controls.refusal: the incumbent-unchanged control did not score below a repairing arm

decision.question: which structure and model should generate the record
decision.admission: the controls did not separate: the incumbent-unchanged arm scored 67.8 % against 32.2 % for the best repairing arm; the withheld-text control is unmeasurable because no held-out member has its right answer only in the enclosing text and is right for one-pass/frontier.
